chunks: And by his chain, from Abd al-Razzaq ibn Hammam, from al-Ma'mar ibn Rashid, from al-Abban ibn Abi Ayyash, from al-Salim ibn Qays, who said:

Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) said: 'One day I passed by a man, who named for me, and he said: "The example of Muhammad is like the example of a date-palm growing in a dunghill." I came to the Messenger of Allah and mentioned that to him. The Messenger of Allah became angry, went out angry, and came to the minbar. The Ansar took up their arms when they saw the anger of the Messenger of Allah.'

He said: 'Why do some people criticize me with my close kinship, after they have heard me saying about them what I say regarding Allah's preference for them, and what He has singled them out for by removing uncleanness from them and purifying them? And they have heard what I said about the virtue of my family and my guardian, and what Allah honored, singled out, and preferred in him: his precedence in Islam, his steadfastness in it, his kinship to me, and that he is to me as Aaron was to Moses.'
Then someone passes by and claims that my example among my family is like a date-palm growing in the base of a dunghill?

Indeed, Allah created His creation and divided them into two parties, and He made me in the best of the two parties. Then He divided that party into three branches, and He made me in the best of them as a branch and the best of them as a tribe. Then He made them families, and He made me in the best of them as a family, until I was purified among my family, my progeny, and the sons of my father: I and my brother Ali ibn Abi Talib.

Allah the Almighty looked at the people of the earth with a glance and chose me from among them. Then He looked with another glance and chose Ali; my brother, my vizier, my heir, my guardian, my caliph in my ummah, and the guardian of every believer after me.

Whoever befriends him has befriended Allah, and whoever opposes him has opposed Allah. Whoever loves him, Allah loves him, and whoever hates him, Allah hates him. No one loves him except every believer, and no one hates him except every disbeliever.
He is the foundation of the earth after me and its ease. He is the word of piety and the firmest handhold of Allah.
They desire to put out the light of Allah with their mouths, but Allah will not consent save to perfect His light, even if the disbelievers hate it.

Some people from my family desire to put out the light of my brother, but Allah will not consent save to perfect His light. O people, let the present among you inform the absent of my speech! Allah, bear witness against them!
Then indeed Allah looked with a third glance and chose my family after me, and they are the best of my ummah: eleven Imams after my brother, one after another. Whenever one perishes, another rises.

Their example among my ummah is like the stars of the sky; whenever a star sets, another rises. Indeed, they are guided Imams, who guide others. The plotting of those who plot against them does not harm them, nor the abandonment of those who abandon them. Rather, Allah harms those who plot against them and abandon them by that.

They are the proofs of Allah on His earth and His witnesses over His creation. Whoever obeys them obeys Allah, and whoever disobeys them disobeys Allah. They are with the Qur'an and the Qur'an is with them; they do not part from it nor it from them, until they come to me at my Pond (in Paradise).
And the first of the Imams is my brother Ali, the best of them, then my son Hasan, then my son Husayn, then nine from the progeny of Husayn.

key_terms.أَهْلُ الْبَيْتِ: The People of the House, referring to the Prophet's family, specifically Ali, Fatima, Hasan, and Husayn.
key_terms.إِذْهَابِ الرَّجْسِ: Removal of impurity/uncleanness, part of the verse of purification.

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the 'dunghill' metaphor and the divine selection of the Ahl al-Bayt in this hadith?
ai.summary: This narration from *Kitab al-Ghayba* highlights the theological concept of *al-Intiqab* (divine selection), where Allah progressively narrows His choice from all humanity to the specific lineage of the Prophet and his Ahl al-Bayt. It establishes Ali ibn Abi Talib as the *Wali* and *Wasi*, linking his authority directly to the Qur'an and foretelling the succession of eleven infallible Imams, whose constancy is compared to the stars of the sky. This text serves as a foundational proof for the Imamate's divine origin and the inseparability of the Imams from the Qur'an until the Day of Judgment.

en.abdullah-al-shahin: (12) Abdurrazak bin Hammam narrated from Ma’mar bin Rashid from Abban bin Abu Ayyash from Sulaym bin Qayss that

Imam Ali (as) had said: “One day I passed by a man, who said: “The example of Muhammad is like the example of a date-palm growing in a dunghill.” I came to the Prophet (S) and told him of that. He became very angry. He went to the minbar. Al-Ansar took up their arms when they saw the Prophet (S) so angry.

He said: “Why do some people criticize my close relatives after they have heard me mentioning that Allah has preferred them to all of the people and has favored them by purifying them and taking uncleanness away from them? They have heard me mentioning the virtues of my family and the virtues of my guardian, whom Allah has honored and preferred because of his precedence in being a Muslim, his defending Islam, his kinship to me and that he is to me as has Aaron been to Moses.
After all, someone of you claims that I am, among my family, like a date-palm growing in a dunghill!

Allah has created his creation and divided them into two parties. He has made me in the best of them. Then He has divided this party into three groups and made me in the best of them and in the best tribe. Then He divided them into families and made me in the best of them until I have been purified with my brother Ali bin Abu Talib from among the family.

Allah the Almighty looked at the people of the earth and chose me from among them and then He looked again and chose Ali; my brother, vizier, heir, my caliph for my umma and the guardian of every believer after me.

Whoever obeys him, obeys Allah and whoever opposes him, opposes Allah. Whoever loves him will be loved by Allah and whoever hates him will be hated by Allah. No one loves him except the believers and no one hates him except the unbelievers.
He is the basis of the earth and its ease after me. He is the word of piety and the firmest handhold of Allah.
“They desire to put out the light of Allah with their mouths, and Allah will not consent save to perfect His light.”
The enemies of Allah want to put out the light of my brother but Allah will not consent save to perfect his light. O people, let the present inform the absent of my speech!

Then Allah looked thirdly and chose some ones from among my family after me. They are the best of my umma; eleven imams after my brother (Ali) one after the other. Whenever one of them leaves to the better world another one will replace him.

Their example is like the stars of the sky; whenever a star sets another will shine. They are guided and guiding imams. They will never be affected by the disappointment of their opponents nor by the plotting of their enemies.

They are the authorities of Allah on the earth and His witnesses over His people. Whoever obeys them, obeys Allah and whoever disobeys them disobeys Allah. They are with the Qur’an and the Qur’an is with them. They will never part with the Qur’an nor will it part with them until they come to me at the pond (in Paradise).
The first of the imams is my brother Ali, who is the best of them, then my son Hasan, then my son Husayn and then nine ones from the progeny of Husayn.” He mentioned all the tradition.
